# `react()`

React on the web. Adds the you-might-not-need-an-effect rules as `@ashstack/effects/`, alongside oxlint's own react plugin.

Plugins: `eslint`, `typescript`, `import`, `unicorn`, `promise`, `oxc`, `react`, `jsx-a11y`, `react-perf`.

## Modules added by this entry

- [`@ashstack/react`](../react.md) — always on via `react()` and every entry above it.
- [`@ashstack/query`](../query.md) — auto-enabled by `react()` when `@tanstack/react-query` is a dependency.
- [`@ashstack/zustand`](../zustand.md) — auto-enabled by `react()` when `zustand` is a dependency.
- [`@ashstack/i18n`](../i18n.md) — auto-enabled by `react()` when an i18n library (i18next, lingui, react-intl, use-intl, next-intl, expo-localization) is a dependency.
- [`@ashstack/stylex`](../stylex.md) — auto-enabled by `react()` when `@stylexjs/stylex` is a dependency.
- [`@ashstack/tailwind`](../tailwind.md) — auto-enabled by `react()` when `tailwindcss` is a dependency.
- [`@ashstack/tanstack-router`](../tanstack-router.md) — auto-enabled by `react()` when `@tanstack/react-router` is a dependency.
- [`@ashstack/effects`](../effects.md) — always on via `react()` and every entry above it, from [eslint-plugin-react-you-might-not-need-an-effect](https://github.com/NickvanDyke/eslint-plugin-react-you-might-not-need-an-effect) (MIT).
